## Task 1 · The grid (2 marks)

Draw a grid: x from 0 to 10, y from 0 to 6. Write the numbers on the axes.

a) Mark the player at P = (4, 2). (1 mark)

b) The player moves 3 steps up. Write the new position. (1 mark)

## Task 2 · One vector (3 marks)

The player is at (2, 1). The coin is at (8, 4).

a) Find the vector from the player to the coin. Use end − start. (2 marks)

b) Check: add your vector to (2, 1). Do you get the coin? (1 mark)
